title: RAVEN data/binary manifest
description: Language-agnostic registry of downloadable raven-toolbox / RAVEN data artefacts and external binary bundles. Consumed by the Python resolvers (raven_toolbox.data / raven_toolbox.binaries) and by MATLAB RAVEN. Every file carries a SHA256 so consumers verify integrity after download.

manifest_version.description: Format version of this manifest document.

generated.description: ISO-8601 date the manifest was generated (informational).

data.description: Data-artefact datasets, keyed by dataset id (e.g. 'kegg'). Maps onto raven_toolbox.data._DATA_REGISTRY.

binaries.description: External command-line tool bundles, keyed by bundle id (e.g. 'blast', 'diamond', 'hmmer'). Maps onto raven_toolbox.binaries._REGISTRY.

url.description: Direct download URL (GitHub release asset, Zenodo file, etc.).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the file.

bytes.description: File size in bytes (informational; for progress bars / sanity checks).

version.description: Dataset version tag, e.g. 'kegg116'. Used in the cache path.

license.description: SPDX id or free text. NOTE: KEGG-derived artefacts are subject to KEGG's terms — confirm redistribution rights before publishing.

doi.description: Zenodo (or other) DOI for this dataset version, if archived.

source.description: Human-facing page for the release/record (GitHub release or Zenodo landing page).

provides.description: Executable names this bundle provides, e.g. ['blastp', 'makeblastdb'].

license.description: Upstream tool license (e.g. DIAMOND is GPL-3.0-only — ship its license text alongside the ZIP).

platforms.description: One entry per platform, keyed '<os>-<arch>' (e.g. 'linux-x86_64', 'macos-arm64', 'windows-x86_64'). Matches raven_toolbox.binaries._platform_key().
